document_api_meta.title: Get Logistics Tracking
document_api_meta.env_desc:
Use this API to retrieve detailed logistics tracking information for an order. This API currently supports only cross-border trade (CBT) orders. Compared with Get Tracking, this API groups information by parcel and can include each parcel's carrier, latest tracking number, and tracking-event history.

For the mapping between `action_code` and `action_code_name`, see https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/37tihrdq.

request_header_param.name: x-tts-access-token
request_header_param.desc: The seller access_token value from [Get Access Token](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a3292b0f40314a92d75#Get%20Access%20Token%20API), when user_type = 0. Follow this [guide](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/678e3a344ddec3030b238fa0) to get seller access_token.

request_query_param.name: app_key
request_query_param.desc: Every single app will have a unique key. Please use the specific key assigned to your app.

request_query_param.name: sign
request_query_param.desc: Signature generated by gen algorithm. When you send API requests to TTS, you must sign them so that TTS can identify the senders.

request_query_param.name: timestamp
request_query_param.desc: Unix timestamp GMT (UTC+00:00). This timestamp is used across all API requests. Developers can use this convert to local time.

request_query_param.name: shop_cipher
request_query_param.desc:
Use this property to pass shop information in requesting the API. Failure in passing the correct value when requesting the API for cross-border shops will return incorrect response. 
Get by API [Get Authorization Shop](https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9?external_id=6507ead7b99d5302be949ba9)

response_param.name: code
response_param.desc: The success or failure status code returned in API response.

response_param.name: message
response_param.desc: The success or failure messages returned in API response. Reasons of failure will be described in the message.

response_param.name: ^logistics_details
response_param.desc: A list of parcels in the order. Each item describes one parcel and can include its carrier, latest tracking number, and tracking-event history.

response_param.name: ^^newest_tracking_no
response_param.desc: The latest logistics tracking number for this parcel.

response_param.name: ^^track_list
response_param.desc: A list of logistics tracking events for this parcel.

response_param.name: ^^^tracking_no
response_param.desc: The logistics tracking number associated with this tracking event.

response_param.name: ^^^update_time_millis
response_param.desc: Unix timestamp in milliseconds (GMT/UTC+00:00) when this tracking event was updated.

response_param.name: ^^^action_code
response_param.desc:
Action code of this tracking event. It is an enumerated status value; the full enumeration list is maintained by the business side.
Refer: action_code/action_code_name mapping details https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/37tihrdq

response_param.name: ^^^action_code_name
response_param.desc: Machine-readable status name corresponding to `action_code`. For action code and name mapping details, see https://partner.tiktokshop.com/docv2/page/37tihrdq.
